text: January 1, 2019 - The Nilo-Saharan language phylum, initially classified by Greenberg, consists of various language families including Eastern Sudanic and Central Sudanic. The classification of certain families, such as Koman and Songhay, is debated, and the study proposes a new categorization based on shared grammatical markers.
